reviews.bounded_author_review: Source qualifications preserved in the meaning of one complete-exception predicate. The program consumes an explicit signed assertion of that whole condition; it does not infer the composite condition from partial events.

exception_interface.meaning: The entire p1 exception applies: the Discloser specifically authorized the otherwise prohibited conduct in advance and in writing. The predicate is not satisfied by later authorization, non-written authorization, nonspecific authorization, or authorization from someone other than the Discloser.
exception_interface.name: p1_advance_written_discloser_authorization_exception_applies

reviews.source_quote: 5. No Reverse Engineering. No party, as Recipient, will decompile, disassemble, reverse engineer or attempt to reconstruct, identify or discover any source code, underlying ideas, techniques or algorithms in Confidential Information by any means whatever, except as may be specifically authorized in advance by Discloser in writing.

exception_interface.meaning: The entire p2 exception applies: the otherwise prohibited conduct is pursuant to an agreement that is mutually acceptable to the parties, written, and executed by the parties. Mere negotiations, unilateral acceptance, an unwritten understanding, or an unexecuted writing do not satisfy this predicate.
exception_interface.name: p2_mutually_acceptable_executed_written_agreement_exception_applies

reviews.source_quote: IV. NO REVERSE ENGINEERING; WORK PRODUCT: Receiving Party shall not reverse-engineer, analyze, attempt to duplicate or otherwise attempt to determine the design or method of compiling samples, prototypes or products of the Originating Party except pursuant to a mutually acceptable, written agreement executed by the parties.
